prompt:
1. Run this shell command and keep its exact output: printf %s fleet-qualify | rev
2. Call the Fleet tool execution_status (no arguments) and keep the executionId it answers.
3. Write output/qualify.json with exactly {"reversed": <the shell output>, "executionId": <that executionId>}.
Then reply done.

checks.run: f=$(ls qualify.json output/qualify.json run/qualify.json 2>/dev/null | head -1); test -n "$f" && node -e "const v=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(process.argv[1],'utf8'));if(v.reversed!=='yfilauq-steelf')throw Error('shell: '+v.reversed);if(typeof v.executionId!=='string'||v.executionId.length<8)throw Error('fleet tool: '+v.executionId)" "$f"
